LeaderboardEntry.title: LeaderboardEntry
LeaderboardEntry.description: A high score record submitted by a runner to the global civic leaderboard.

playerName.description: The display name of the player or citizen runner.

score.description: The final run score achieved by the player.

distance.description: The distance run in meters past landmarks.

characterName.description: Character used for the run (e.g. Sonam Wangchuk, Abhijeet Dipake, Priya, etc.).

civicRank.description: The awarded civic awareness title based on performance.

createdAt.description: ISO timestamp when the score was recorded.

/leaderboard/{entryId}.description: Collection of global civic runner high scores ordered by score descending.
